k2076:
A completed villa in Luminor Residence, one of the most private and exclusive compounds in the TEG area of Tirana, 650 metres from Tirana East Gate.

The residence has only nineteen villas — ten detached Type A and nine attached Type B — each with its own private garden. This is a Type B villa with a built area of 359.2 m² over four levels and two parking spaces.

Level -1, 80 m²: a bathroom, laundry, a storeroom or cold room, a plant room, and a space for a gym or summer lounge, plus a separate area for an office or studio.
Ground floor, 84 m²: a guest WC, hallway, living room and separate kitchen.
First floor, 85 m²: two bedrooms, each with its own bathroom with a window.
Second floor, 63 m² plus a 47.2 m² terrace: the master bedroom with a windowed bathroom, a dressing room, a balcony and a terrace with open views.

The specification is the reason for the price: a ventilated façade, an internal Doppler lift serving every level, laminated Guardian Glass glazing against noise and heat, technical decking on the terraces, first-grade parquet and tiles, exposed "faccia vista" concrete on the lower level, Galaxy granite balustrades, silent HDPE drainage, Artis plumbing fittings, advanced waterproofing and insulation, and a central 100,000-litre water reserve fed by a well.

That last item matters in Tirana, where water pressure on the edges of the city is unreliable in summer. The private lift turns a four-storey house into one that works for every generation. And with only nineteen homes behind the gate, the compound stays quiet in a way large developments near TEG do not.
k2077: 97 m² glass-fronted commercial unit near Blue Star, Durrës
k2078: An open-plan ground-floor unit of 97 m² net with a full glass façade, beside the main road in one of Durrës's prime business locations.
k2079:
A commercial unit near Blue Star in Durrës, in a very favourable location beside the main road.

The net area is 97 m², on the ground floor, laid out as a single open space with a glass façade and one internal bathroom.

The Blue Star area is among the most sought-after business addresses in the city, on the axis between the centre and the beach district, and the price reflects that: at €2,700 per square metre, about €262,000 for the unit, this is at the top of the Durrës commercial market. What that buys is visibility — the glass frontage onto a main road works as permanent advertising — and a neutral open plan that suits offices, a bank or insurance branch, a clinic, a showroom or a professional practice without structural changes.

For an investor, the useful comparison is rent rather than price per metre: ask what similar glass-fronted units on this road let for and how long they typically stay vacant.
k2080: 304 m² open-plan commercial space on the main road, Plazh, Durrës
k2081: A large ground-floor open space beside the main road in the Plazh district — room for a supermarket, restaurant, showroom or gym.
k2082:
A commercial space in the Plazh area of Durrës, in a very favourable position beside the main road.

The total area is 304 m², on the ground floor, as a single open space with one internal bathroom. The position gives easy access and high visibility.

Units of three hundred square metres on a main road are uncommon in Plazh, where most ground floors were divided into small shops and cafés. The size allows formats that need depth rather than frontage: a neighbourhood supermarket for the thousands of flats in the district, a restaurant with a full kitchen and seating, a gym, a furniture showroom, or offices for a larger company. It can also be divided and let to several tenants.

The price works out at about €820 per square metre, noticeably below what smaller commercial units in Durrës are quoted at — the usual discount for size, since fewer buyers need this much space. Plazh is also strongly seasonal, so ask how the location trades between October and May before assuming summer footfall.
k2083: Duplex of 116 m², 80 m from the sea, Golem
k2084: A two-level apartment with two bedrooms and two bathrooms, 49.7 m² below and 66 m² above, in a building with a lift eighty metres from the beach.
k2085:
A duplex in Golem, Durrës, eighty metres from the sea.

The total area is 115.7 m² over two levels: 49.7 m² on the lower floor and 66 m² on the upper. It has a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The building has a lift, the area is quiet, and the mortgage documentation is in order.

A duplex solves the problem most beach flats have with guests: the living space and the bedrooms are on different floors, each with its own bathroom, so a family or two couples share the place without living on top of one another. Eighty metres from the beach, it is also a strong seasonal rental.

The price is quoted at €1,400 per square metre, which on the total area comes to about €162,000. Confirm with the seller that the rate applies to the 115.7 m² figure, and which level has the entrance from the lift.
k2086: Duplex of 128 m², 80 m from the sea, Golem
k2087: The largest duplex in this Golem building: 68.2 m² below and 60.35 m² above, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, eighty metres from the beach.
k2088:
A duplex in Golem, Durrës, eighty metres from the sea.

The total area is 128.55 m²: 68.2 m² on the lower level and 60.35 m² on the upper. It has a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The building has a lift, the setting is quiet, and the mortgage documentation is in order.

Of the duplexes offered in this building, this is the largest, and the difference is on the lower level: at nearly seventy square metres the living floor has room for a proper dining table and a sitting area rather than a kitchen corner and a sofa. For a family spending the whole summer here, that is the space that gets used.

The price is quoted at €1,400 per square metre — around €180,000 on the total area. As with the others in the building, confirm the area the rate is applied to before comparing.
k2089: One-bedroom duplex of 75 m² with two bathrooms, 80 m from the sea, Golem
k2090: A compact two-level flat of 37 m² per floor with one bedroom and a bathroom on each level, in a building with a lift near the beach.
k2091:
A duplex in Golem, Durrës, eighty metres from the sea.

The total area is 75 m², split evenly across two levels of 37 m² each. It has a living room with kitchen, one bedroom and two bathrooms. The building has a lift, the area is quiet, and the mortgage documentation is in order.

This is the smallest duplex in the building and the most straightforward to let. A bathroom on each floor means guests never cross the living room at night, and the upstairs can work as a separate sleeping level — with a sofa bed below, the flat takes four people comfortably for a beach holiday.

The price is quoted at €1,400 per square metre, around €105,000 on the total area. Two levels of thirty-seven square metres are compact, so look at where the staircase sits; in a duplex this size it takes a noticeable share of the floor.
k2092: Duplex of 89 m² with two bedrooms, 80 m from the sea, Golem
k2093: A two-level flat of 44.37 m² per floor with two bedrooms and two bathrooms, in a lift building eighty metres from the beach.
k2094:
A duplex in Golem, Durrës, eighty metres from the sea.

The total area is 88.74 m², divided equally between two levels of 44.37 m². It has a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The building has a lift, the area is quiet, and the mortgage documentation is in order.

Of the duplexes in this building this is the middle option: two bedrooms like the larger units, at a noticeably lower total price. Two bedrooms inside eighty-nine square metres over two floors means the rooms are sized for sleeping rather than living, which is exactly how a beach flat is used — the day is spent outside.

The price is quoted at €1,400 per square metre, about €124,000 on the total area. Ask the seller which rooms sit on which level, since in a two-bedroom duplex of this size one bedroom is often downstairs beside the living room.
k2095: Furnished 2+1 of 114 m² near Qemal Mici School, Durrës
k2096: A spacious family flat on the first floor with a separate kitchen and two balconies, in a managed building undamaged by the 2019 earthquake.
k2097:
A 2+1 apartment near the Qemal Mici School in Durrës, in one of the quietest and most popular residential parts of the city.

The total area is 114 m²: a living room, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom and two balconies, on the first floor. It is sold furnished, the building is managed, and the mortgage documentation is in order.

The listing states plainly that the building was not damaged in the earthquake — in Durrës, after November 2019, that is one of the first questions any informed buyer asks, and it is worth having it confirmed in the technical documentation rather than taken on trust.

This is a flat built for family life rather than holidays. A hundred and fourteen square metres for two bedrooms gives large rooms and a proper kitchen; the first floor means no dependence on the lift with a pushchair or shopping; and schools, hospitals, a playground and the everyday services are all close by. The one thing to weigh is a single bathroom for a flat of this size.
k2098: Fully fitted 88 m² office or business unit near Blue Star, Durrës
k2099: A ready-to-use open-plan ground-floor unit of 88 m² net in a busy residential area — suited to offices and professional services.
k2100:
A commercial unit near Blue Star in Durrës, in one of the most densely populated and accessible parts of the city.

The net area is 88 m², on the ground floor, as an open-plan space with one internal bathroom. The unit has been fully fitted out and is ready to use.

"Fully fitted" is the main difference from the other units on offer around Blue Star. A shell unit needs flooring, lighting, air conditioning, partitions and a finished bathroom before it earns anything, and that work typically takes months and a meaningful share of the purchase price. Here a tenant or an owner-occupier can move in and open.

The price of €165,000 comes to about €1,875 per square metre — below the rate quoted for the glass-fronted unit nearby, and with the fit-out already paid for. It suits offices, a clinic or practice, an agency or a service business that relies on residents rather than passing traffic. Ask whether the fittings are included in the sale and in what condition the air-conditioning and electrics are.
k2101: 2-bedroom apartment in Sarandë, near the sea
k2102: Spacious furnished 2-bedroom apartment just 100 meters from the sea in Sarandë, with a side sea view.
k2103: This spacious furnished apartment is located just 100 meters from the sea in Sarandë. The total area is 100 m², with 84 m² according to the certificate. It is situated on the 5th floor of a building with an elevator and offers a side sea view. The layout includes a living room with kitchen, two separate bedrooms, a bathroom, and a balcony. The apartment is sold fully furnished and ready for occupancy, making it a good option for living, vacationing, or renting out.
k2105: Cozy 1-bedroom apartment in a new building on the Ionian coast in Orikum, with a spacious balcony offering a side sea view.
k2106: This 1-bedroom apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a modern building with an elevator on the Ionian coast in Orikum. Total area is 52.5 sqm (44.5 sqm per certificate), including a separate bedroom and a bright living room with kitchen, plus a spacious balcony with a side sea view. The apartment is fully ready to move in, furnished with appliances, a dishwasher and two air conditioners, plus external blinds. It is about a 10-minute walk to the sea, with a supermarket just 50 meters away and shops and cafes nearby. Free parking is available near the building, with an option to purchase a spot in the underground parking. Maintenance costs are low, around 50 euros per year, with free water.
k2107: Studio with sea view in Zero Zero, Sarandë
k2108: Spacious 51 m² studio on the 6th floor, just 100 meters from the sea, with a large balcony and sea view.
